_metadata.quantity: mean bond length from refined inorganic crystal structures, per ion configuration
_metadata.source_file: BL data.xlsx, aggregated by O. C. Gagne

references.a: Gagne, O.C. & Hawthorne, F.C. (2016). Acta Cryst. B72, 602-625. Alkali and alkaline-earth metals.
references.b: Gagne, O.C. (2018). Acta Cryst. B74, 49-62. Lanthanides and actinides.
references.c: Gagne, O.C. & Hawthorne, F.C. (2018a). Acta Cryst. B74, 63-78. Metalloids and post-transition metals.
references.d: Gagne, O.C. & Hawthorne, F.C. (2018b). Acta Cryst. B74, 79-96. Non-metals.
references.e: Gagne, O.C. & Hawthorne, F.C. (2020). IUCrJ 7, 581-629. Transition metals.

fields.min: shortest single bond observed in the sample
fields.max: longest single bond observed in the sample

_metadata.note: Measured, not derived. Gagne states these data are more accurate and comprehensive than values obtained by adding ionic radii and should be used in their stead wherever possible; G&H (2020) sec 7 makes the same point. Use mean as the expected distance and min as a measured floor for a short-contact screen.
